out.subject: 1.4404 bar – volume commitment and indexed pricing
out.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your offer and the explanation of your cost structure. I appreciate the transparency. Alongside the annual index movements you cite, please consider the market evidence below when reviewing the starting price.

We propose a binding volume of 23700 kg per year throughout the selected contract term, rather than a short-term purchasing arrangement. The following packages give you a choice of commitment length and index treatment:

24 months at EUR 5.40 per kg, with an AS-14404 clause and a 5% deadband.
36 months at EUR 5.40 per kg, with the same clause and deadband.
36 months at EUR 5.28 per kg, with an AS-14404 clause and no deadband.

All packages carry payment at 90 days net. The index clause uses a 45% material share and base month 2026-08.

This gives Werdenfels committed annual volume and an explicit mechanism for alloy movements. In return, we ask for the starting price in the selected package to reflect that commitment and the referenced market evidence. Which package would you support?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing
out.rationale: Offer committed annual volume across both contract lengths, with indexed pricing and a no-deadband variant. Use the alloy-index evidence to support a lower starting price while inviting the supplier to select its preferred package.
